notes: Car-height rock. First size in the set the kart can be stopped by, so the collision proxy starts to matter here — it is the exact convex solid, inflated four centimetres, which is as tight as a proxy gets.

rules.placement: Car-height discrete outcrops in turf and alpine stone; solid obstacle the kart can hit.
rules.avoid: Avoid wetland mud flats where stone should be rare.
